notes_for_editor: Thin-to-moderate evidence. Construction from the Light-House Board 1891 report (OCR badly damaged; first-lighting date illegible in OCR so Lighthouse Friends gives New Year's Eve 1890; FY1891 report assumed, volume labelled 1891-1892). Disagreements stated in text: caisson diameter 26 ft (Board) vs 25 ft (LF); fog bell start 20 Apr 1891 (notice) vs 30 Apr (LF); lens upgrade Nov 1901 (notice) vs 1902 (LF); original lens fifth order (Board) vs fourth (D'Entremont); Morrison principal 1930-38 (USLHS) vs 1920-38 (D'Entremont); Knight head keeper 1926-30 (USLHS) vs assistant (D'Entremont). Roster dates are USLHS lines; Manchester appears as assistant 1940 in USLHS and as substitute keeper in LF. The 1888 Board request is quoted via Lighthouse Friends; the 1888 report is not in the corpus. National Register listing date (1988) not verified from a source read; characteristic Fl W 6s and range not verified (Light List not read). Page 'printed' numbers for archive.org volumes are unconfirmed (marked scan page). Newspaper 1895-06-03 lists Angie W. Tapley as assistant keeper at Goose Rocks in a list of appointments; not used. Verifier: USLHS also gives original optic as fourth order (agrees with D'Entremont; Board and Lighthouse Friends say fifth); USLHS lists Jim Woods as head keeper while his own account describes a Coast Guard crew.
